snippet.title: Dragon's Tear | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Lead three Tear hunters in a first-person idle dungeon crawler. Collect monsters' Tears, awaken their powers and wield them in automatic battles. Farm cleared floors while away as you seek the most powerful Tear of all: the Dragon's Tear, said to grant any wish.

Wishlist on steam
